title: 3D scene manifest, schema 2: the generic 3D viewer's asset manifest (K-R104)
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §4.5 (K-R104; promised by K-R64). The shape of map/estate/model/manifest.json and map/props/<id>/manifest.json, read from core/scene3d-manifest.mjs (validate / glbParts): `id` and one resolvable `glb` are the only hard requirements; every other field is optional and unknown fields are kept (additionalProperties true). Paths are relative to the manifest's own directory.

id.description: Asset id (the main scene: the manifest's own id; a landmark: its directory name).

anyOf.description: { std, low? }: one part, two tiers.
{ <part>: { std, low? } }: several parts (the main scene: site / house).

glb.description: The model file(s), three forms; the legacy landmark form is glb plus glb_low.

glb_low.description: Legacy landmark spelling: the low tier of the main part.

label.description: The floor's name in the viewer (K-R132); the floor id when absent.

floors.description: Floor ids, bottom to top (checked against the room plan's floors); an item may carry `label` and `i18n` (K-R132).

hotspots.description: Landmark hotspots; the main scene's outdoor hotspots live in data.zones.

budget.description: Size / tier budget; the legacy per-group `budgets` is read as well.

license.description: Credit and licence; the legacy `credit` is read as { credit }.

data.description: Data file paths, relative to the manifest's directory.

extras.description: Optional pack data file: room aliases, sub-areas and vehicles of the building (data/extras shape in docs/kernel-schema.md K-R131).

flows.description: Animated flow paths (dots along a polyline).

anyOf.description: K-R132: the building's title and subtitle (plain text, put on the page with textContent); the viewer says "Building" and shows no subtitle without it. A `floors` key is rejected: floor labels live on floors[] items.
Legacy landmark spelling: the bounding box of the whole model (read by props/viewer3d.html); not the K-R132 block.

building.description: K-R132: the building's words { title, subtitle?, i18n? }, or (legacy landmark manifests) the model's bounding box { min, max }.

rank.description: Label priority: 1 is shown first, 3 last (2 when absent).

room_kinds.description: K-R131: room kind -> plate colour and legend label (plain text). A kind a room uses and the table lacks gets a generated colour-vision-safe colour and its id as label.

view.description: Optional camera framing of the exterior view in metres (layout coordinates: x east, y north, z up); the model's bounding box when absent.
